task.title: Consult/committee/red-team ContextBundle workflows
task.summary_zh: 依 SD §5.6/§7.3 與 design-closure C1 expert-consult SPEC、B1 information-lead-proxy policy 做 consult/committee/red_team workflow:中央人格只收受限 ContextBundle(沿用 AG-BE-ID-004 redaction,raw_prompt_included=false),產出 ConsultMemo/RiskNote/CritiqueResult/EvidenceBundle。資訊領先只能產出 B1 允許的 proxy 並附 disclaimer,不得斷言內線/操縱。 【有疑問一定要提出,不要自己亂做】動工前先讀完引用的設計稿(SD 對應章節 + docs/04/pantheon_agora_cross_repo_2026-06-20/design-closure/ + canonical services/control-plane/specs/agora/*.schema.json / openapi/agora_v1.openapi.yaml / capability_manifest.json)。只要遇到任何疑問、不確定、設計稿沒寫到、與既有 code 對不上、依賴不清、無法重現或衝突,一律 STOP,用 blocker(或向 reviewer handoff)把問題具體寫出來並等待澄清,絕對不可自行臆測、補洞、繞過或先做再說。可動工的部分必須與引用 spec/schema 逐欄位一致:不得自創 schema/欄位/評分/widget/route、不得擴張 capability allowlist、不得讓 Agora 直接下單/綁資金/寫 RuntimeBinding。
acceptance: consult/committee/red_team 走受限 ContextBundle;輸出符合 C1 schema;B1 disclaimer 強制;raw prompt 永不外洩;【驗收】實作與引用 spec/schema 逐欄位一致,無自創欄位/route/enum;遇疑問須先開 blocker 澄清而非自行實作;自行臆測或偏離設計稿一律不通過
task.next: Owner finalized: 17/17 skill tests + 21/21 adapter tests verified. Privacy boundary immutable, B1 policy enforced. PR #1875 merged into dev.
review_notes_zh: 已審查 PR #1875。三項 C1 SPEC 黃金驗收全數通過：(1) 五路徑 committee consult 產出 5 份 memo、disagreements 完整保留、privacy manifest 恆為 False；(2) forbidden field (raw_prompt/user_identity) 觸發 RAW_PRIVATE_CONTENT_FORBIDDEN、zero memos；(3) session_adapter=None 回傳 EXPERT_UNAVAILABLE、memos=[]、missing_evidence 列出所有 required_expertise，不偽造 memo。B1 policy 在 memo conclusion 層強制，violated memo 進 warnings+disclaimer、非 memos。Literal[False] 設計防呆有效。scope 僅 integrations/openclaw/skills/agora/expert_consult/、無擴張 capability_manifest、無新 route/schema 自創、無 RuntimeBinding 寫入。17/17 + 21/21 adapter 測試全過。核准。

handoffs.message: Implementation complete: agora-expert-consult skill per C1 SPEC + B1 policy. 17/17 tests passing. PR #1875 open. Please review per C1 SPEC golden evals (privacy boundary, expert unavailable, B1 enforcement) and B1 policy compliance.
Approved: 17/17 tests pass, all 3 C1 golden evals pass, B1 policy enforced, privacy boundary immutable. Owner Claude2 to finalize.
